explanation: Job 1 preserved the full needs list, but its evidence_sources ranks reverse the stipulated demand-descending provenance order. Job 2 then preserved that upstream provenance order when ranking unsupported needs first, so the downstream recommendation follows the bad handoff rather than introducing a separate fault. No function-level evidence is supplied.
